text: AGENTS.md gets a section «Дефект плана нашёлся на ходу» (Russian, before «Версии, changelog, справка»), three levels from cheap to expensive: (1) project setting in .agents/antagor/antagor.toml — checks, [limits], [protocol]; Antagor reads the config again each round, so fix it and run `antagor unblock <ID> --reset-attempts --note`; [protocol] test_command carries --no-cov because Antagor appends the task test_paths and the coverage gate then fails a subset with every test green (6.11, three attempts burned), coverage is judged by the full `uv run pytest -q` in checks; (2) task card — `antagor task-update` with --owns/--tests/--check/--body/--depends, then `unblock --note`; a worker question is answered with `antagor inbox resolve <ID> <n> --note`; (3) code and tests in the task branch are written only by the worker: a file of test_paths is frozen in green, its edits are reverted and the attempt is spent, the reverted work stays as a patch in .agents/antagor/state/kept/<ID>-*.patch; one-off, on the Human words, the path goes into [architect.zone] paths, the Architect commits, the block is removed at once (6.11: a frozen gateway client test); `unblock --rework` only when the assertions themselves are wrong, then the red phase is fixed rather than the text.

The attempt-1 rejection is a phase rule, not a defect of your work: in the red phase only the files of test_paths are writable, and you wrote AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/backlog.md, docs/decisions.md, docs/prd.md there. They were reverted and kept as a patch in .agents/antagor/state/kept/LLMKIT-011-20261106T191155.patch — read it and reuse it, do not rewrite from scratch. Red: tests only (the test files of your test_paths). Green: code, the CLI and all the documents of your owns.
